contract: A current measured goal comparison, a calendar-day deadline, a local evidence handoff, or an explicitly requested fraction of the distance from baseline to target. Decline unrelated, unsafe, conditional, ambiguous, wrong-unit and external requests. A percentage-of-target calculation requires revision 1.1.0.
